hooks.logic:
Let part be part 2 of the acting enemy.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form "2" on part.
Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
Reset part.
Let v be a revive sequence {deformTag: "deformation_01", nos: [2], filteringDeformPosArray: [1, 2]}.
V → unshift with ([{builtin: "DIE_FORCIBLY", dieNos: [1]}]).
Queue the pose-change sequence v.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

hooks.logic:
Let nextSummonFamiliersIndex be the register's 'nextSummonFamiliersIndex'.
Reset part list at nextSummonFamiliersIndex's 'childNo' of the enemy.
Queue the pose-change sequence a revive sequence {deformTag: list at nextSummonFamiliersIndex's 'deformTag', nos: [list at nextSummonFamiliersIndex's 'childNo']}.
Increase the register's 'nextSummonFamiliersIndex' by one.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

Given arg1, arg2.
Return the first x in arg1 where the value "no" of x is arg2.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
If the current state is 11, then
  Change state to 12.
  Return false.
Otherwise, return the current state is not 12 and (not call helper with (arg, 2) or (do given (part) { Finish off part. } for each item of the parts of the acting enemy, then true)).

flow.text: the current state is 11

no.text: Return the current state is not 12 and (not call helper with (arg, 2) or (do given (part) { Finish off part. } for each item of the parts of the acting enemy, then true)).

script_hooks.logic:
Let nextSummonFamiliersIndex be the register's 'nextSummonFamiliersIndex'.
Let v be nextSummonFamiliersIndex minus 1.
If len is at most nextSummonFamiliersIndex, then return false.
If v is at least 0, then
  Let v2 be list at v.
  If part v2's 'childNo' of the enemy is alive, then return false.
Return the HP fraction of part 2 of the enemy is at most the numeric entry list at nextSummonFamiliersIndex's 'aiArgTag' in the battle settings of the enemy.

script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 2 of the enemy.
The script register.
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ABILITY_MAGIC_SUMMON" is up this frame, then choose state 14 next and stop.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form "3" on part.
If the value "paramId" of part is not paramIdBySuffixNo, then
  If the HP fraction of part is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_phase_2" in the battle settings of the enemy, then
    Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
    Part cancels its cast and stop.
If part is ready to act, then
  If run helper3, then part uses the move labelled "magic_summon".
  Otherwise, part → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
